app_fee.value: All international applicants pay a non-refundable $90 application evaluation charge.
app_fee.quote: All international students are required to pay a non-refundable $90 application evaluation charge.

fee_waiver.value: The application evaluation charge has no exceptions, so no fee waiver is offered.
fee_waiver.quote: A non-refundable application evaluation charge is required of all applicants. | There are no exceptions to this policy.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE rule; each program sets its own, see the program records.
gre_general.quote: The University of Texas at Arlington does not set minimum GRE or GMAT requirements that apply to all students. | Individual programs or departments determine GRE and GMAT requirements for admission to their programs.

toefl_min.value: Non-native speakers need a TOEFL iBT total of at least 79.
toefl_min.quote: achieve a minimum TOEFL iBT total score of 79

ielts_min.value: Non-native speakers need an IELTS Academic score of at least 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: Graduate master’s and doctoral applicants from non-native English speaking countries are expected to submit a score of at least 6.5 on the IELTS

english_waiver.value: Applicants who graduated from schools in India need no English test score, so Indian applicants do not submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have graduated from secondary schools or post-secondary schools in the following countries meet the English language proficiency required for admission and need not submit TOEFL iBT, IELTS or Duolingo examination results | Gambia, Ghana, Gibraltar, Guam, India, Kenya

notes: Source: UT Arlington graduate admissions section of the University Catalog (graduate.pdf). The uta.edu admissions pages returned HTTP 502 during research, so the catalog is the only source. A teaching assistantship still needs TOEFL Speaking 23 or IELTS Speaking 7 (catalog, English Proficiency Requirements for Graduate Teaching Assistants).
